Players Committee card image of [[Tatooine: Mos Espa (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “'''Light Side:''' For remainder of game, may not be separated from Watto's Junkyard. '''Dark Side:''' Your characters here and at Watto's Junkyard are immune to opponent's Sandwhirl.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/tatooinemosespa.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 6489b69] (10 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
